# Context Layer

> Context Layer is a working protocol proposal for giving applications and agents purpose-bound context without exposing a user's entire private memory.

This public site is a synthetic demonstrator. It does not connect to a production vault, claim standards adoption, or certify a security implementation.

## Canonical sections

- /#why — problem, protocol, proof, and proposal status
- /#demo — deterministic synthetic context flow
- /#map — progressive architecture explorer
- /#guide — protocol Q&A and allowlisted same-page navigation
- /#reference — specification and implementation documents
- /writing/context-layer — published essay by Sierra Catalina
- /reference/architecture — zoomable complete architecture diagram
- /reference/specification — rendered draft technical specification
- /reference/implementation — rendered implementation and interoperability profiles

## Core flow

1. A requester declares a purpose and fields.
2. A user-controlled vault evaluates private context.
3. Policy allows, reduces, denies, or requests approval.
4. A recipient-bound scoped context bundle expires after use.
5. An interface uses the bundle without receiving the raw vault.
6. A receipt records the decision and action without duplicating raw private data.
